mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior month compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return distribution in periods with declining FEDFUNDS is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate exceeding 0.3 percentage points over the prior 3 months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, triggering negative S&P 500 returns within the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where UNRATE rises > 0.3pp in 3 months or Rank IC is negative.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) indicates weakening demand and supply conditions, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and INDPRO both decline > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of cases where both HOUST and INDPRO decline > 0.5% in 1 month or Rank IC is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 3.5% annualized), a sustained increase in the consumer price index triggers aggressive monetary tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 3.5% annualized or Rank IC is negative.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) over the prior month signals expanding manufacturing output, leading to positive S&P 500 returns within the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) in periods of rising INDPRO or Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPIAUCSL reading exceeding 3.5% annualized growth rate triggers a market reaction anticipating aggressive central bank policy, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 3.5% annualized or Rank IC is negative.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 4.0% and a decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 4.0% signals a monetary policy response to labor market weakness, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: monetary policy easing amid labor market weakness
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where UNRATE > 4.0% and FEDFUNDS < 4.0% or Rank IC is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle economic regime, a decline in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) exceeding 0.5% in the prior month signals weakening labor demand, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances during late-cycle expansion when PAYEMS declines > 0.5% or Rank IC is negative.
